name: Typed lines, camera dive
what: Three lines type in on a dark ground while a camera moves through them: a small line types in close up, the camera whips out as a huge main word types in, dives into the main word until its letters fill the top of the frame while a small bottom line types in, then pulls back out to show all three.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f2-f48 (00:00:00:02-00:00:01:18) the top line types in at a close zoom (1.19 x); f50-f60 (00:00:01:20-00:00:02:00) the camera whips out and up to 0.88 x; f54-f88 (00:00:01:24-00:00:02:28) the main word types in, one letter every 4 frames; f88-f110 (00:00:02:28-00:00:03:20) the camera dives into the main word (0.92 x to 1.42 x), motion-blurred, accelerating then braking, while the bottom line types in (f92-f136); f110-f150 (00:00:03:20-00:00:05:00) it holds with a slight sway; f150-f182 (00:00:05:00-00:00:06:02) it pulls back out to 1 x and settles; f182-f210 a slow drift to the end. The reference only changes every second frame (15 fps content); the template moves on every frame

tracks.name: top line types
tracks.what: the top line types in, one character every 2 frames, at a close zoom

tracks.name: camera whip
tracks.what: the camera whips out and up (1.19 x to 0.88 x)

tracks.name: main word types
tracks.what: the main word types in, one letter every 4 frames, with a pause for the space

tracks.name: dive
tracks.what: the camera dives into the main word until its letters fill the top of the frame (0.92 x to 1.42 x), with motion blur

tracks.name: bottom line types
tracks.what: the small centred bottom line types in under the main word

tracks.name: hold
tracks.what: the camera rests on the huge letters with a slight sway

tracks.name: pull back
tracks.what: the camera pulls back and up to show all three lines, then settles and drifts
